rongmei.title: Jisu ta pam khanv tow the

lines: 1 Jisu ta Pam khanv tow the, Kamei akhang biuc the,
Ching ruh pangc khou akhang Kamei gay liang e,
Kamei nzaengc Lili e, Kakhou ramh guay nai the,
Ata khiu ’than khang, ata tiigaylou khang;
Ryanra khou swm gaylou e, katuak khou ’khavlou e,
Kadanmei guay Kakhou lou khang saa e;
Kamei nzaengcbaek Lili e, Lauthwan Gaanphiu kiu e,
Ching ruh pang khou akhang Kamei gay liang e.
Ryanra khou swm gaylou e, katuakc khou ’khavloue,
Kadanmei guay Kakhou lou khang saa e;
Kamei Nzaengcbaek Lili e, Lauthwan Gaanphiu kiu e,
Ching ruh pang khou akhang Kamei gay liang e.
2 Alung ryanramei guay 8^& Kamei ^&8 phungclou the,
Pwanzingh ganv khou akhang duploupuikai e;
Kakhang ^&8 ai kahawme ravmaengc guay ganc pat the,
’Taw thu ata Kangamv ^&8 sin gaeklou the;
Dih ^&8 ganc rulou sini, Seitaan ^&8 ’thiam sihni,
Jisu paan ^&8 gayna ai kai tangc ni;
Kamei nzaengcbaek Lili e, Lauthwan Gaanphiu kiu e,
Ching ruh pang khou akhang Kamei gay liang e.
3 Ata ganc ’rulou lak ge, ata ’patlou lak ge,
Kakhou lwmna Kachwn khou ai lungc pwkhou,
Mai ^&8 akhang raengh swlou, ai ping dat khang maek khe,
’Daapcmei abumaengc ta tii-n-gulou the;
Thei thangc tingkauh ku pwkhou, Kazawpaanv how pwkhou,
Neihlaamei kanganv nai dat pw lak khe;
Kamei nzaengcbaek Lili e, Lauthwan Gaanphiu kiu e;
Ching ruh pang khou akhang Kamei gay liang e.
